description: Flood defences is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Oxford City Council. This record is for Approval for Access (AfA) product AfA006. This dataset shows, flood defences protecting against river floods with a 1 per cent (1 in 100) chance of happening each year, or sea floods with a 0.5 per cent (1 in 200) chance of happening each year, together with some, but not all, defences ... Coverage: Oxford City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Oxford City Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2017-03-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
